strategy.overview: Pinball Lizard rewards an early upper-left saucer: it raises Bonus X and lights the right spinner for the rest of the game. After that, keep sending the ball up top with the safer orbit, spinner, or saucer route; the narrow left 50,000 lane is valuable only when its miss and rebound are under control.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot the upper-left saucer early to raise Bonus X and light the right spinner. Then keep sending the ball up top; use the narrow left 50,000 lane only if you can hit it safely.
strategy.summary: Get the saucer once, build the persistent multiplier through A-B-C-D-E, PINBALL, or more saucer shots, and favor repeatable up-top feeds over risky standups.

quickInfo.name: First Priority
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the upper-left saucer to raise Bonus X and light the spinner.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete A-B-C-D-E, complete PINBALL, or shoot the saucer.

steps.text: Shoot the upper-left saucer once as early as possible; it raises Bonus X and lights the right spinner.
Use the right spinner, saucer, or left-side star-rollover orbit to return the ball to the top.
Complete A-B-C-D-E or both PINBALL banks to raise the multiplier, which carries across balls.
Build base bonus with drop targets and keep using the safest up-top route.

alternatives.title: 50,000 lane
alternatives.when: Use this only when the narrow left lane is hittable and a miss does not create uncontrolled side-to-side action.

steps.text: Settle the ball on the right flipper.
Shoot the narrow far-left lane for 50,000.
Return to the up-top plan after any dangerous rejection.
Raise Bonus X through the saucer, lane set, or PINBALL banks.
Advance the base bonus with drop targets toward 29,000.
Protect the ball and preserve the multiplied end-of-ball payout.

machineSetup: Test the upper-left saucer and eject, right spinner, A-B-C and D-E lanes, both PINBALL banks, left 50,000 lane, and bonus lamps.
Confirm Bonus X carryover, Extra Ball and Special conversion, and whether the left-lane miss is recoverable.
